items.title: Advent of Sysadmin 2025
items.title_zh: 2025 系统管理员降临节
items.summary: Advent of Sysadmin 2025 was a 12-day calendar of Linux and DevOps challenges at varying difficulty that ran from December 1 to 12; the event has ended, but its scenarios remain available with clues and solutions.

items.title: Last Week on My Mac: Losing confidence
items.title_zh: 上周的 Mac：信心流失
items.summary: The column argues that confidence, which it calls essential to learning to drive, ride a bike or speak a foreign language, matters just as much in computing and in macOS.

items.title: Apple Releases Open Weights Video Model
items.title_zh: 苹果发布开放权重视频模型
items.summary: The project page describes a research program reviving normalizing flows as scalable, end-to-end, likelihood-based generators spanning images, video, language, and unified multimodality.

items.title: What will enter the public domain in 2026?
items.title_zh: 2026 年哪些作品将进入公有领域？
items.summary: The Public Domain Review highlights the works that will enter the public domain on January 1, 2026.

items.title: Micron Announces Exit from Crucial Consumer Business
items.title_zh: 美光宣布退出 Crucial 消费业务
items.summary: Micron announced that it is exiting its Crucial consumer business, according to the company's news release.

items.title: Booting Linux in QEMU and Writing PID 1 in Go to Illustrate Kernel as Program
items.title_zh: 在 QEMU 中启动 Linux 并用 Go 编写 PID 1，说明内核只是一个程序
items.summary: The post argues that the Linux kernel is just a binary you can build and run, using experiments that boot Linux in QEMU and write PID 1 in Go to demystify what courses usually leave as a black box.

items.title: Transparent leadership beats servant leadership
items.title_zh: 透明式领导胜过服务式领导
items.summary: Drawing on a couple of years managing a team and on reading about servant leadership, the author likens servant leadership to "curling parenting", where the leader sweeps problems out of the way for direct reports, and argues for transparent leadership instead.

items.title: Influential study on glyphosate safety retracted 25 years after publication
items.title_zh: 草甘膦安全性重要研究发表 25 年后被撤稿
items.summary: An influential study on glyphosate safety was retracted 25 years after its publication.

items.title: 4 billion if statements (2023)
items.title_zh: 40 亿条 if 语句（2023）
items.summary: A blog post revisits a screenshot in which a novice programmer tackles the modulus operation with billions of if statements, drawing critical comments.

items.title: Sam Altman’s DRAM Deal
items.title_zh: Sam Altman 的 DRAM 交易
items.summary: A commentary piece describes DDR5 memory prices spiking, citing a 32GB kit bought in early November that was listed at $330 three weeks later, a 156% increase.

items.title: Google Titans architecture, helping AI have long-term memory
items.title_zh: Google Titans 架构：帮助 AI 拥有长期记忆
items.summary: Google Research introduces the Titans architecture and the MIRAS framework, which it says let models work much faster and handle massive contexts by updating their core memory while running.

items.title: Z2 – Lithographically fabricated IC in a garage fab
items.title_zh: Z2：在车库晶圆厂光刻制造的集成电路
items.summary: The author describes Z2, a 100-transistor test chip made with a 10 µm polysilicon gate process in a garage fab, the same technology as Intel's first processor. He says he has now fabricated 1,200 transistors on one piece of silicon, against the 2,200 in the Intel 4004.

items.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (December 2025)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：谁在招聘？（2025 年 12 月）
items.summary: The December 2025 edition of Hacker News’ Who is hiring thread asks employers to state location and remote status, and to post only for their own company and only for roles they are actively filling.

items.title: Search tool that only returns content created before ChatGPT's public release
items.title_zh: 只返回 ChatGPT 公开发布前内容的搜索工具
items.summary: Slop Evader is a search tool and browser extension for Chrome and Firefox that aims to help users avoid AI-generated web content by filtering results.

items.title: Cloth Simulation
items.title_zh: 布料模拟
items.summary: A web page demonstrating a cloth simulation.

items.title: Show HN: I built a dashboard to compare mortgage rates across 120 credit unions
items.title_zh: Show HN：我做了一个对比 120 家信用合作社房贷利率的仪表盘
items.summary: A developer built a dashboard that pulls public mortgage rates from more than 120 credit union websites and compares them against the weekly FRED national benchmark.

items.title: Uncloud - Tool for deploying containerised apps across servers without k8s
items.title_zh: Uncloud：无需 Kubernetes 即可跨服务器部署容器应用
items.summary: Uncloud deploys and scales Docker Compose apps across cloud VMs and self-hosted servers, pitched as a simpler alternative to Kubernetes, Swarm, Nomad and Kamal.

items.title: I'm Peter Roberts, immigration attorney who does work for YC and startups. AMA
items.title_zh: 我是 Peter Roberts，为 YC 和初创公司服务的移民律师，欢迎提问
items.summary: Immigration attorney Peter Roberts, who works with YC and startups, answered reader questions in a Hacker News AMA and noted that he cannot give legal advice on specific cases.

items.title: Tiny Core Linux: a 23 MB Linux distro with graphical desktop
items.title_zh: Tiny Core Linux：23 MB 的图形桌面 Linux 发行版
items.summary: Tiny Core Linux is a highly modular distribution built from a recent Linux kernel and a small core filesystem, with TinyCore adding a lightweight FLTK/FLWM graphical desktop.

items.title: Go is portable, until it isn't
items.title_zh: Go 是可移植的，直到它不再可移植
items.summary: The post explores the limits of Go's portability when integrating with system-specific C libraries such as libsystemd and when dealing with glibc versus musl systems.

items.title: Xiaomi says humanoid robots to be deployed across its factories within five years

items.title: Look AI makes the future of fashion design real-time, AI-powered, and in your hands

items.summary: Look AI, a product of a Shenzhen-based technology company, is presented as bringing real-time, AI-powered tools to fashion design.
